_note: MINERVA Aqawan 1 (roll-off; holds T1 and T2, which cannot collide).
One file for the enclosure, read by both services (robofast_core/config.py):
Every address is a 127.0.0.1 placeholder: replace it on the control network.
dome: the Aqawan Alpaca server (deploy/aqawan.example.json listens on 11113).
safetymonitor, observingconditions: the site weather bridge (sites/minerva/weather.yaml listens on 11111).
t1, t2: ASCOM Remote on each telescope's Windows PC, serving its mount (PWI4) and camera as device 0.
safety and sequencer: SafetyConfig and SequencerConfig fields; omitted ones take the defaults in docs/design.md section 6.
plan: calibration frames only, until the dispatch scheduler exists; or run with --plan targets.json.
name: aqawan1
